collaborative teaching approaches to online and blended learning can be categorized into four distinct models: (1.) traditional face-to-face teaching with online support; (2.) online teaching with on site support; (3.) on site leadership, where the instructor is physically on site but the student is online; and (4.) off site leadership, where both instructor and student are online.

the three new collaborative teaching approaches to blending learning are (1) on-site leadership, where the teacher is physically present at the site and is in charge of the class, (2) on-site leadership where the teacher is not physically present but in charge of the classroom, and (3), co-teaching, where the teacher and the technology expert are in charge of the lesson.
